version.changelog: Refreshed this Chinese scene skill so its shared setup, API-key, upload, and command guidance now matches the latest official sparki-video-editor skill while preserving scene-specific positioning.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: video-resizer-zh
Version: 1.0.9

The video-resizer-zh skill bundle is a legitimate CLI tool and agent instruction set for interacting with the Sparki AI video editing API. The code (cli.py, client.py) implements standard API workflows for authentication, file uploading, and task polling using well-known libraries like httpx and typer. The SKILL.md file provides clear, task-oriented instructions for the AI agent without any evidence of prompt injection or malicious redirection. Permissions are appropriately restricted to the tool's own configuration and workspace directories, and the network access is limited to the official API domain (agent-api.sparki.io).

llm.summary: The skill's code, runtime instructions, and requested access line up with a Sparki video-resizing CLI: it asks for a Sparki API key, talks only to agent-api.sparki.io / the Sparki Telegram upload link, and only needs read/write access to its own config/workspace paths.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (video resizing for platform aspect ratios) match the included CLI code and SKILL.md. The primary credential (SPARKI_API_KEY) and network domain (agent-api.sparki.io) are appropriate for a Sparki-integrated editor. File read/write permissions target the skill's config and workspace directories, which is expected.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run the sparki CLI commands (setup, upload-tg, run/edit/status/download) and to only accept uploads via local path or the Telegram mini-app link. It does not ask for unrelated system files or unrelated credentials. The directive to proactively use this skill for video-related requests is broad but coherent with its purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This package contains a Python CLI and pyproject.toml, but the registry summary said 'No install spec'. The SKILL.md metadata includes an 'install' entry that runs 'uv sync' (and requires the 'uv' binary). That explains how the sparki CLI would be made available, but it relies on the 'uv' tool being present. If the platform does not run the declared install step, the 'sparki' command may not exist and commands will fail. No external download URLs or odd installers are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only the Sparki API key (SPARKI_API_KEY) is the primary credential and is used by the code. No unrelated secrets or broad cloud credentials are requested. The client code also optionally reads SPARKI_UPLOAD_TG_LINK from env which aligns with upload behavior. Number and scope of env/config accesses are proportional.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false, no request for system-wide privileges, and the skill writes only to its own config and workspace paths. It does not modify other skills or global agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent for a Sparki video-resizer: it needs your Sparki API key and will upload video files to Sparki's API / Telegram mini-app. Before installing or providing a key: 1) Confirm you trust sparki.io / the Sparki Telegram bot because the API key grants access to your Sparki account and any uploaded videos. 2) Ensure you are comfortable sending videos to an external service (avoid uploading sensitive content). 3) Note the skill expects the 'uv' tool to run 'uv sync' (per its metadata) to make the 'sparki' CLI available — if your environment doesn't run that install step the commands will fail. 4) Check where output files will be written (~/.openclaw/workspace/sparki/videos) and that you are okay with that storage location. If you want more assurance, verify the base_url and upload link the skill will use match the official Sparki endpoints before providing your API key.
